dialogues.jp: 「……もう、暗くなってきたのか」
dialogues.en: "...Geez, it's dark already."
dialogues.text: "...Geez, it's dark already."

dialogues.jp: 門にもたれかかり、ひとつ息をつく。
dialogues.en: Leaning against the school gate, I let out a small sigh.
dialogues.text: Leaning against the school gate, I let out a small sigh.

dialogues.jp:
あれから、講師に捕まってしまって、不純異性
交遊がどうたらいう、ありがたい念仏を聞かせ
てもらった。
dialogues.en:
In the end, we were caught by a lecturer, and I thanked God
that we weren't punished with anything worse than a
scolding.
dialogues.text:
In the end, we were caught by a lecturer, and I thanked God
that we weren't punished with anything worse than a
scolding.

dialogues.jp:
元々が品行方正だったことりは、何とか、曲の
演奏時間の直前に解放されたが、俺は３割増だっ
た。
dialogues.en:
But in order to prevent chaos, he ordered that I would not
be able to attend the trio's performance for the graduation
party.
dialogues.text:
But in order to prevent chaos, he ordered that I would not
be able to attend the trio's performance for the graduation
party.

dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
おかげで、ことり達の勇姿を見る事は叶わなかっ
たのだ。ったく、マネージャーだってのに。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to that, I ended up not being able to see Kotori's
gallant figure in full flight. What a crappy manager I was.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to that, I ended up not being able to see Kotori's
gallant figure in full flight. What a crappy manager I was.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「や、ことり、お疲れ……って、他のふたり
　は？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Kotori, good wo... huh, where's the other two?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Kotori, good wo... huh, where's the other two?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「人の恋路を邪魔すると、馬に蹴られちゃうか
　らって」
dialogues.en:
"They didn't want to be in the middle of a romantic moment,
so they left first."
dialogues.text:
"They didn't want to be in the middle of a romantic moment,
so they left first."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……まぁた、変に気を回して。みんなで、ぱ
　あっと、打ち上げとかしたかったんだけど」
dialogues.en: "...Once again, those weird implications."
dialogues.text: "...Once again, those weird implications."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね」
dialogues.en: "Hehe."
dialogues.text: "Hehe."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうだった？　演奏の方は」
dialogues.en: "How was it? The performance, I mean."
dialogues.text: "How was it? The performance, I mean."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは満足げにうなずくと、ぐっと親指を立
てた。
dialogues.en: Kotori nodded, satisfied, and gave me a thumbs-up.
dialogues.text: Kotori nodded, satisfied, and gave me a thumbs-up.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もう、バッチリ。すっごい決まったよ。曲が
　終わったら、割れるような拍手で……」
dialogues.en:
"Absolutely perfect. We ended spectacularly, as well. At the
end, the applause was deafening..."
dialogues.text:
"Absolutely perfect. We ended spectacularly, as well. At the
end, the applause was deafening..."

dialogues.jp:
まるで、その時の音に耳を傾けるように、こと
りは目をつむった。
dialogues.en:
So to say, she closed her eyes as soon as the song ended and
let her hears tell her everything she needed to know.
dialogues.text:
So to say, she closed her eyes as soon as the song ended and
let her hears tell her everything she needed to know.

dialogues.jp: 「おめでとう」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう……これも、朝倉君のおかげです」
dialogues.en: "Thank you... We couldn't have done it without you, either."
dialogues.text: "Thank you... We couldn't have done it without you, either."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや。俺の力なんて……ま、ともかく帰
　ろうか。家まで送るよ」
dialogues.en:
"No no, I didn't do anything... anyway, let's go. I'd walk
you home."
dialogues.text:
"No no, I didn't do anything... anyway, let's go. I'd walk
you home."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: と、不意にことりが表情を緩めた。
dialogues.en: All of a sudden, Kotori's expression softened even further.
dialogues.text: All of a sudden, Kotori's expression softened even further.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふ……うふふ……」
dialogues.en: "Ehe... hehehe..."
dialogues.text: "Ehe... hehehe..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何よ？　変な風に笑っちゃって」
dialogues.en: "W, what? You're laughing weirdly..."
dialogues.text: "W, what? You're laughing weirdly..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「変な風なんかじゃないよ」
dialogues.en: "It isn't weird."
dialogues.text: "It isn't weird."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、嬉しいじゃない」
dialogues.en: "I'm just happy."
dialogues.text: "I'm just happy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私達、恋人同士さんなんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "We're lovers now, aren't we?"
dialogues.text: "We're lovers now, aren't we?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何だか私、嬉しくて嬉しくて。ついつい、頬
　が弛んじゃうよ」
dialogues.en:
"Even if I wanted to, I can't stop smiling and giggling once
in a while to myself now..."
dialogues.text:
"Even if I wanted to, I can't stop smiling and giggling once
in a while to myself now..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「恋人同士、か……まぁ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Lovers... yeah, I guess."
dialogues.text: "Lovers... yeah, I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜……なんか、つれない言い方」
dialogues.en: "Heeey, you don't sound very happy."
dialogues.text: "Heeey, you don't sound very happy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、そんな事ないぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Naaah, that's not true."
dialogues.text: "Naaah, that's not true."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、ほら、朝倉君も笑って笑って」
dialogues.en: "Then come on, smile for me!"
dialogues.text: "Then come on, smile for me!"

dialogues.jp:
にやにやと笑いながら、脇腹を肘でちょいちょ
いつついてくる。
dialogues.en: She grinned and elbowed me lightly.
dialogues.text: She grinned and elbowed me lightly.

dialogues.jp: 「わっ、はっ、はっ、はっ、はっ、はっ」
dialogues.en: "Wa, ha ha ha ha ha ha ha."
dialogues.text: "Wa, ha ha ha ha ha ha ha."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……何ですか、その笑い方は」
dialogues.en: "...What's with that laugh?"
dialogues.text: "...What's with that laugh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「スパルトイＸのボス風味だ」
dialogues.en: "It's from the final boss of Spartoy X."
dialogues.text: "It's from the final boss of Spartoy X."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、私達、恋人なんだよね？」
dialogues.en: "But now we're lovers, right?"
dialogues.text: "But now we're lovers, right?"

dialogues.jp: くるっとこちらに向き、微笑み掛けてくる。
dialogues.en: Sho looked towards me and smiled sweetly.
dialogues.text: Sho looked towards me and smiled sweetly.

dialogues.jp: 「……ちなみに、それ｛き／訊｝いてくるの、３回目」
dialogues.en:
"...By the way, that makes the third time you've asked that
now."
dialogues.text:
"...By the way, that makes the third time you've asked that
now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　やだなあ、まだたったそれだけなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Eh? It can't be only that little..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? It can't be only that little..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何回言うつもり？」
dialogues.en: "How many times do you plan to say it, then?"
dialogues.text: "How many times do you plan to say it, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……何度でも。だって、この嬉しさを、いつ
　までも噛みしめていたいんだもん」
dialogues.en:
"...Several. It'd take a long time for me to digest this
happiness. Let me chew on it for awhile."
dialogues.text:
"...Several. It'd take a long time for me to digest this
happiness. Let me chew on it for awhile."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……やれやれ。牛のようにか」
dialogues.en: "...Aye aye, just like a cow."
dialogues.text: "...Aye aye, just like a cow."

dialogues.jp:
嬉しいくせに、何となく、憎まれ口を叩いてみ
る。
dialogues.en:
I was just as happy really, but my sarcastic language still
came to the fore.
dialogues.text:
I was just as happy really, but my sarcastic language still
came to the fore.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「たくさん食べて、すぐに寝るといいかな？」
dialogues.en: "Eating a lot then sleeping, sounds good though."
dialogues.text: "Eating a lot then sleeping, sounds good though."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……太るだろ」
dialogues.en: "...You'd get fat."
dialogues.text: "...You'd get fat."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん……残念」
dialogues.en: "True... too bad."
dialogues.text: "True... too bad."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも……やっぱ、実感湧かないよな……」
dialogues.en: "Heh... our true feelings couldn't reach him..."
dialogues.text: "Heh... our true feelings couldn't reach him..."

dialogues.jp:
完全に闇色になった空を見上げ、春の空気にぽ
つりと呟きをもらす。
dialogues.en:
I stared up into the dark sky, and talked into the spring
wind.
dialogues.text:
I stared up into the dark sky, and talked into the spring
wind.

dialogues.jp:
島のこっちの方には桜はないはずなのに、何だ
か、花の香りをかいだような気がした。
dialogues.en:
Although the island's sakura petals weren't fluttering at
this time, I could still smell their scent.
dialogues.text:
Although the island's sakura petals weren't fluttering at
this time, I could still smell their scent.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それはそうだよ。だって、わずか、数時間前
　のことなんだから」
dialogues.en: "That's true... just look at what happened just now."
dialogues.text: "That's true... just look at what happened just now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「わずかって感じでもないな。講師に捕まって
　いた時間を振り返るに」
dialogues.en:
"It doesn't even feel like just now. I'm still looking over
my shoulder occasionally to check."
dialogues.text:
"It doesn't even feel like just now. I'm still looking over
my shoulder occasionally to check."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あれは、辛かったよね」
dialogues.en: "That was horrible."
dialogues.text: "That was horrible."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もう、顔がにやけそうで仕方がないのに、殊
　勝な顔してないといけないんだもん」
dialogues.en:
"Geez, it's not our fault that we get stared at by the
entire student body as someone to be looked up to..."
dialogues.text:
"Geez, it's not our fault that we get stared at by the
entire student body as someone to be looked up to..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それは、辛い」
dialogues.en: "That's painful."
dialogues.text: "That's painful."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ」
dialogues.en: "Isn't it."
dialogues.text: "Isn't it."

dialogues.jp:
道行く人の合間を、ふたり並んでゆっくりと歩
いていく。なるべく亀になったつもりだったの
に、白河家はもうすぐだった。
dialogues.en:
We continued walking down the road, the two of us together.
We slowed our speed, not wanting to reach her home just yet.
dialogues.text:
We continued walking down the road, the two of us together.
We slowed our speed, not wanting to reach her home just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Is something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Is something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、ちょっと冷えるな」
dialogues.en: "It's starting to get a bit cold."
dialogues.text: "It's starting to get a bit cold."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうかな？　日が落ちても、結構、暖かいと
　思うけど……」
dialogues.en:
"You think? Now that the sun's down, it feels just right for
me..."
dialogues.text:
"You think? Now that the sun's down, it feels just right for
me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……う〜ん、そこで、寒いって言ってくれな
　いと」
dialogues.en: "...Hmm, that wasn't what you were supposed to say."
dialogues.text: "...Hmm, that wasn't what you were supposed to say."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ポケットに突っ込んでいた手を出した。
dialogues.en: I took my hand out from my pocket.
dialogues.text: I took my hand out from my pocket.

dialogues.jp:
「“手、温めてやろうか”とか何とか、言おう
　と思ったのに」
dialogues.en:
""Let me warm your hand". Now that would have been
appropriate."
dialogues.text:
""Let me warm your hand". Now that would have been
appropriate."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今からでも、遅くないかな？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't it a bit late for that now?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't it a bit late for that now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん」
dialogues.en: "Pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Pretty much."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……今日、寒いよね」
dialogues.en: "...It's starting to get a bit cold."
dialogues.text: "...It's starting to get a bit cold."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとだよな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it sure is."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it sure is."

dialogues.jp: 言いながら、そっと手を握る。
dialogues.en: As soon as she said that, I took her hand.
dialogues.text: As soon as she said that, I took her hand.

dialogues.jp: ことりの手は、柔らかく、温かかった。
dialogues.en: Her hand was soft and warm.
dialogues.text: Her hand was soft and warm.

dialogues.jp:
心がほぐれていくような……舞い上がってしま
うような。
dialogues.en:
I felt as if our hearts were connected through that physical
contact.
dialogues.text:
I felt as if our hearts were connected through that physical
contact.

dialogues.jp: 鼓動が加速を始める。
dialogues.en: My hearbeat started increasing rapidly.
dialogues.text: My hearbeat started increasing rapidly.

dialogues.jp: 胸が痛い。
dialogues.en: My chest began to pound.
dialogues.text: My chest began to pound.

dialogues.jp: だけど、この痛みは心地よかった。
dialogues.en: But this time, the pounding was a heavenly feeling.
dialogues.text: But this time, the pounding was a heavenly feeling.

dialogues.jp:
（でも、このドキドキがことりに伝わってたり
　するかもしれないと思うと……）
dialogues.en: "(I wonder if she's feeling the same way...)"
dialogues.text: "(I wonder if she's feeling the same way...)"

dialogues.jp: 何だか恥ずかしいような気もした。
dialogues.en: I started feeling a little embrassed.
dialogues.text: I started feeling a little embrassed.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫だよ。私だってドキドキしてるもん
　……」
dialogues.en: "It's okay, my heart is pounding too."
dialogues.text: "It's okay, my heart is pounding too."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「みんなの前でキスするより、ドキドキしちゃ
　うねって。そう言ったの」
dialogues.en: "When we kissed in front of everyone else, at that time..."
dialogues.text: "When we kissed in front of everyone else, at that time..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだな……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, that..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, that..."

dialogues.jp: じんわりと広がっていく温かさ。
dialogues.en: Gradually, I started feeling warmth all over.
dialogues.text: Gradually, I started feeling warmth all over.

dialogues.jp: これが、恋人同士って奴なのかな……。
dialogues.en: Is this what lovers do...
dialogues.text: Is this what lovers do...

dialogues.jp: そんなこんなで、ことりの家の前に着いた。
dialogues.en: Eventually, we reached the front of Kotori's house.
dialogues.text: Eventually, we reached the front of Kotori's house.

dialogues.jp: 名残惜しく、繋がりがほどかれる。
dialogues.en: Reluctantly, I let go of her hand.
dialogues.text: Reluctantly, I let go of her hand.

dialogues.jp: 門の前で、ことりが振り返った。
dialogues.en: Just in front of her gate, Kotori turned around.
dialogues.text: Just in front of her gate, Kotori turned around.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ね、朝倉君。明日、デートしよっ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun. Let's go on a date tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun. Let's go on a date tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「デート……」
dialogues.en: "A date..."
dialogues.text: "A date..."

dialogues.jp:
その響きにじ〜んとなりながら、俺はこっくり
とうなずいた。
dialogues.en:
As that word reverberated around my brain for awhile, I
slowly nodded.
dialogues.text:
As that word reverberated around my brain for awhile, I
slowly nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「いいなっ」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、１２時に風見学園で待ち合わせって事
　にしない？」
dialogues.en: "Then, shall we meet at the school gates at 12?"
dialogues.text: "Then, shall we meet at the school gates at 12?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「分かった。もう、夜も寝ないで待ってる」
dialogues.en: "Got it. Geez, now I'd end up staying up all night waiting."
dialogues.text: "Got it. Geez, now I'd end up staying up all night waiting."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私と会っている時に、寝たりしないでね」
dialogues.en: "Don't be sleeping when we meet!"
dialogues.text: "Don't be sleeping when we meet!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そんな事言っている私が、眠っちゃう
　かも」
dialogues.en: "Then again, I'd probably be guilty of the same thing..."
dialogues.text: "Then again, I'd probably be guilty of the same thing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何で？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「わくわくしすぎて、布団の中で目が冴えちゃ
　うかもしれないからっ」
dialogues.en: "I'm still so excited, I don't think I can sleep..."
dialogues.text: "I'm still so excited, I don't think I can sleep..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、バイバイ！」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, bye bye!"

dialogues.jp: 手を振ると、さっと家の中に入ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Giving me a quick wave, she suddenly disappeared into her
house.
dialogues.text:
Giving me a quick wave, she suddenly disappeared into her
house.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺も、睡眠薬でも買った方がいいかもな」
dialogues.en: "...Me too, maybe I should buy some sleeping pills."
dialogues.text: "...Me too, maybe I should buy some sleeping pills."

dialogues.jp:
手の中にまだ残っているぬくもりを逃がさない
よう、俺はギュッと握りしめた。
dialogues.en:
I gripped my hand tightly, not wanting the leftover warmth
on it to escape.
dialogues.text:
I gripped my hand tightly, not wanting the leftover warmth
on it to escape.

dialogues.jp: ◆恋人◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lovers◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lovers◆

dialogues.jp:
演奏は聴けなかったけれど、ことり曰くバッチ
リだという。良かった。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't watch the performance, but Kotori said it went
perfectly. I'm glad.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't watch the performance, but Kotori said it went
perfectly. I'm glad.

dialogues.jp:
そして俺達は、一緒に帰った。何だか、甘った
るい雰囲気で。
dialogues.en:
Then I walked Kotori home. The atmosphere seems even sweeter
than usual.
dialogues.text:
Then I walked Kotori home. The atmosphere seems even sweeter
than usual.
